en.headline: Hang Seng closes down about 159 points after Fed and HKMA rate rises
en.dek: The benchmark index finished Thursday at 24,554.50, off 0.64 per cent, as investors digested the first US rate increase since 2023 and the matching Base Rate lift.
body: Hong Kong stocks closed lower on Thursday, with the Hang Seng Index falling 159.28 points, or 0.64 per cent, to 24,554.50 after the Federal Reserve’s quarter-point rate rise and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority’s matching increase in the Base Rate to 4.25 per cent.

The index had opened more than 200 points lower and traded in negative territory throughout the session. Technology and financial shares were among the weaker sectors as the market adjusted to the first US tightening since 2023.

Major local banks including HSBC, Bank of China (Hong Kong) and Standard Chartered kept their prime lending rates unchanged despite the Base Rate move. Turnover remained moderate as investors weighed the near-term impact of higher funding costs against the broader economic outlook.

The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index and Hang Seng Tech Index also finished lower. Analysts noted that any pressure on Hong Kong equities from the rate moves was expected to be relatively short-lived.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌約159點 市場消化美息及基本利率上調
zh.dek: 恒生指數周四收報24,554.50點，跌159.28點或0.64%，投資者消化聯儲局加息及金管局同步上調基本利率至4.25厘。
body: 港股周四收市向下，恒生指數下跌159.28點，或0.64%，報24,554.50點。市場消化美國聯儲局加息四分一厘，以及香港金融管理局按聯繫匯率公式將基本利率上調至4.25厘。
恒指早段低開逾200點，全日維持跌勢。科技股及金融股相對疲弱，投資者調整對2023年以來首次美國加息的預期。
匯豐、中銀香港及渣打等主要銀行均宣布維持港元最優惠利率不變。成交量維持溫和，市場繼續評估資金成本上升的短期影響及整體經濟前景。
恒生中國企業指數及恒生科技指數亦收低。有分析指利率變動對港股的壓力料屬短暫。
